validation.app: ballstick and vdw version-matched submitted stereo passed

validation.full_suites: No application runtime behavior changed; prior commit broad-suite debt is retained in vr_transform_stream_20261021.json.

conclusion.grouping: No repeatable gain sufficient to change default eight-instance groups. All 32 group sweep conditions preserve exact offline RGBA/depth/ID images.
conclusion.culling: About 5–6 ms improvement, but one depth pixel differs in each style and 20/5 color channels differ for ballstick/VDW; remains experimental.
conclusion.direct_normal: No useful gain; ballstick has two changed color channels.
conclusion.bottleneck: 137493 atom spheres at 720 triangles each = 98994960 sphere triangles per eye, plus ballstick bonds. One-pixel viewport and constant fragment probes retain substantial GPU cost; mesh processing is the leading target, not proven single hardware stage.
conclusion.next: Explicit sphere primitive transport and perspective-correct analytic GPU spheres preserving source centers/radii/colors. Validate asymmetric stereo, near-plane/camera-inside cases, occlusion with bonds, depth/object IDs, model transforms and fallback before enabling. Existing native billboard shader is not by itself a fidelity proof.

limitations: Offline both-eye mesh rendering; no runtime submission, canonical shadow pass, menus or mirror. Synthetic shadow texture.
Captured eye JSON precision; native silhouette agreement is checked separately.
One 24HB job, two representations. No new CPD performance claim or physical headset comfort claim.
Raw GPU elapsed includes scheduling contention. Full-stream export-mode playback is not a production-transform comparison.
